description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. The in-game right menu gains a "Fullscreen display" toggle: the same feature as the launcher settings page, applied to the current window immediately and persisted with the theme settings.
2. Custom Vulkan driver loading is generalized: driver plugins can declare the driver library name and the target GPU family (adreno/mali/any), enabling Mali panvk drivers; existing Turnip plugins are unaffected.
3. Disabling the FML early-loading window now only applies to MC 26.3+; older versions get the mod-loading progress animation back.
4. Fixed all settings being reset because old data failed to decode after the Vulkan driver setting was renamed (DataStore now ignores unknown keys and Vulkan records gained default values).
5. The favorites page's multi-select action bar is now laid out in two rows, fixing buttons overflowing the screen on narrow displays which made it impossible to exit multi-select (#1938).
6. The built-in file manager now always shows all files (the hidden-file filter and its toggle were removed), fixing ".minecraft" and other dot-prefixed directories being invisible (#1935).
7. Fixed an NPE crash from stale gamepad events whose device is null after a momentary disconnect (#1936).

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.右菜单新增「全屏显示」开关：与启动器设置页的全屏功能相同，切换即时生效并持久化到主题设置
2.自定义 Vulkan 驱动加载泛化：驱动插件可声明驱动库名与目标 GPU 家族（adreno/mali/any），支持 Mali panvk 驱动；旧 Turnip 插件不受影响
3.关闭 FML 早期加载屏现仅对 MC 26.3+ 生效，更早版本恢复模组加载进度动画
4.修复 Vulkan 驱动设置项改名后旧数据解码失败导致全部设置被重置
5.收藏页多选操作栏改为两行排布，修复窄屏下按钮溢出屏幕、无法取消多选 (#1938)
6.内置文件管理器始终显示全部文件（移除隐藏文件过滤与「显示隐藏文件」开关），修复 .minecraft 等以「.」开头的目录不可见 (#1935)
7.修复手柄瞬间断开后残留事件的 device 为 null 导致崩溃 (#1936)
